audit_metadata.verdict_explanation: The 100Q Agentic dataset in final_three_way_100.jsonl originates from a verified live sequential execution (agentic_full_100.jsonl, 73.54 min total latency, 725,493 tokens, 296 agent steps, 107 tool calls, 6 HTTP timeouts at 120s) executed on 2026-09-26. Phase 11 was an evaluation consolidation pass (build_phase11_three_way.py) that normalized and merged the three live baselines rather than re-querying the LLM backend from scratch. The FreeLLMAPI 24h dashboard filter correctly displayed only 4 requests because the live benchmark was executed 58 hours earlier, while the 4 recorded requests were from Phase 10 smoke tests executed on 2026-09-28.

dashboard_reconciliation.explanation: The 24h filter covers 2026-09-28 01:45 to 2026-09-29 01:45. The 100Q benchmark was executed on 2026-09-26 15:13 to 17:11 (58 hours ago). The 4 requests captured in the 24h window correspond exactly to the Phase 10 live smoke tests (test_phase10_live_smoke.py and GRIP/MCP live integration tests) executed on 2026-09-28 23:25-23:38.
